round_history.retrieved_content:
[DAY3 20:11:30 - DAY3 20:12:00]
I look outside toward the pool and see Shure igniting something. Tasha comes over again and pours milk. Shure: "Transport the fire source." I watch Shure walk out holding a burning piece of cardboard. "Does it help if I block it for you?" I ask as I spread my arms to block the flames. "Does it help a bit?" I ask. Shure: "Just walk slowly, it's fine." I go outside with them and escort the burning cardboard forward. Shure: "Just don't let the curtain catch fire." Shure: "It burned out again." I keep moving forward. Shure: "Damn it." "Haha," I say.

[DAY3 20:12:30 - DAY3 20:12:59]
Shure says, "Whoa, just put it in and light it directly." I follow Shure cautiously out toward the oven. "Yeah, yeah, that's right," I say. "Awesome," I say. "Great success," I say. I continue walking to the oven. "Is it a great success?" I ask. I place the burning cardboard into the oven. "It should've worked," I say. Shure says, "It should have worked a bit."

[DAY3 20:13:00 - DAY3 20:13:27]
Shure: Where's that clip? I observe the combustion and continue monitoring the flames. Shure: Where did the clip go? I turn right and spin around once, continuing to watch the fire. I watch Shure add charcoal to the flames. Shure: What's this fire accelerant, I remember. I watch from the sidelines.
